notes.title: Biwar Legend Of Dragon Slayer Demo Live Stream and Talks with Developers.
notes.content:
These are pre-recorded footages, we are going to broadcast some playthroughs and trailers. If you have any questions. Feel free to ask us anything via Chat or Join us Discord server to more discuss!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/About_Game.png?t=1657413170

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/Features.png?t=1657413170

 Play as Biwar, a teenager from Papua island who adventures in the forbidden forest to discover the truth about a dragon and why his parents died. The game is set in a beautiful ancient Balinese environment and Papuan folklore is unique to Nusantara
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/EPCI_ENVIRONMENT.gif?t=1657413170

 Adventure to explore forgotten Balinese ancient mystical environment and solve puzzles using magic mechanics, such as Telekinesis power, red and blue elements, and Non-Euclidean puzzle
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/animasi_puzzles02.gif?t=1657413170

 Fight Mythology Creatures with a machete (Indonesian sword), shield, and bow of magic elements. Attack them with multi-style action and finally defeat the dragon
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/stylized_combat02.gif?t=1657413170



Join Discord server to discuss with the dev and of other players!
